verdicts.reason: Both use the same structure: a big centred headline, then the CTA pushed left and the LIMITED badge drifting off on its own to the right. That breaks the centred axis and the original's tight badge-and-button group, and the badge has swapped sides. B is slightly worse because its headline runs closer to the side edges and its CTA sits only about 25px from the left edge, which looks jammed; A keeps a little more margin all round.
